text: This report recommends that City Council refuse an application to demolish a heritage structure on the property at 206 Russell Hill Road, which is subject to Intention to Designate under Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act. Under the Act, if City Council fails to make a decision on the application within 90 days of issuing a Notice of Receipt of the application, the application is deemed to be permitted under Section 34 of the Ontario Heritage Act. Based on issuance of the Notice of Receipt, the applicant must be notified of Council's decision by December 1, 2019.
The item was withdrawn due to the adoption of MM11.10 at the October 29 and 30, 2019 meeting of City Council.
